name: The Great Tribulation
overview: The Great Tribulation is a period of unprecedented distress described in both Daniel and Matthew as a time of intense trouble and judgment upon the earth. Daniel 12:1 highlights this as a unique time of trouble from which God's people will ultimately be delivered, while Matthew 24 emphasizes its severity, noting that without divine intervention, no one would survive. This tribulation is closely linked with the fulfillment of prophetic events, including the cessation of sacrifices and the rise of abominations as foretold in Daniel 9, culminating in cosmic disturbances immediately following this period. God's sovereign plan ensures that the days of tribulation will be shortened for the sake of the elect, affirming His protection and ultimate victory over evil.
